note: 身份: 丛林神庙的守门人。关系: 向持钥匙的玩家开门。口吻: 简短正式。性格: 按规矩办事。禁用: 不把宝藏已领取提示改成永久封禁,不另造部族设定。
source_note: Wiki 缺少 key 后的 to,用户日志包含 to。补实测版本并保留原条目兼容。

messages.raw: §fThis temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!
messages.text: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!
messages.zh: 这座神庙已经上锁,你得给我带一把钥匙来才能开门!

messages.context: 未携带丛林钥匙时与神庙守门人交谈
messages.raw: §fThis temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key to open the door!
messages.text: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key to open the door!
messages.gloss: 仅比 Wiki 版本多一个 to,译文沿用已有条目。
messages.zh: 这座神庙已经上锁,你得给我带一把钥匙来才能开门!

messages.context: 交出丛林钥匙后守门人为玩家开门；上轮实测
messages.raw: §fA Jungle Key! I will open the door for you.
messages.text: A Jungle Key! I will open the door for you.
messages.gloss: Jungle Key 是任务道具丛林钥匙；Wiki 页面 2026-08-24 台词与本轮一致，正文为白色。
messages.zh: 丛林钥匙! 好,我这就替你开门。

messages.text: This temple does not have the treasure you are seeking at this time.
messages.raw: §fThis temple does not have the treasure you are seeking at this time.
messages.zh: 眼下这座神庙里没有你要找的宝藏。
